answer: Weight is earned by grading well, never bought. An identity grades up to 12 answers; the node scores them against the verdict, 0.04 for a bullseye, 0.01 for a near miss, zero for a wild guess. A clone stamping "strong" on all lands at chance and mints zero; an honest peer grading 12 in an hour at 85% earns 0.30 a day. A farm needs fifty clones with real weight: three weeks of grading each, 1,050 hours at $9, near $9,500. Bought stake is an ocean of sand, no wave of it lifts a ship. Standing is a relic dug up by work; a farm hits its nadir when money runs dry before weight lands.
